purpose: Photographic embroidery wordmark with transparent background. Original publisher cover art is not modified.
prompt: Use case: product-mockup. Create a premium photorealistic embroidered wordmark asset for a personal library website. Text EXACTLY: "Athenaeum." (A t h e n a e u m followed by a period). One single horizontal line in elegant bold Georgia-like literary serif lettering, wide composition, centered, generous tiny clear margin, no extra text. The letters are actual dense, softly padded satin-stitch embroidery photographed from directly above. Individual silk/cotton floss strands cross the strokes and curve around bowls and serifs naturally; show the twisted fine filaments, tiny fuzzy fibers, small imperfections, soft contact shadows, and convincing raised relief. Delicate dusty rose pink, lavender and pale blue iridescent thread colors across the lettering. It must look physically sewn and tactile like macro photography of luxury embroidered fabric, not chrome, not metallic extrusion, not vector text with diagonal stripes, not grainy digital noise. Transparent background, only the stitched letters and subtle contact shadows; no fabric rectangle, no frame, no badge. Crisp exact readable text. High resolution, wide wordmark.
